answers.question: What benchmarks, datasets, or evaluation methods did the radar first see today?
answers.signal: Most of today's first-observed records are agentic evaluation harnesses.
answers.plain_english: Most new items today test whether a model can carry out a task, not just answer a question.
answers.takeaway: Expect harness setup cost, not just a scoring script.
